FAQ.title: Frequently Asked Questions
FAQ.description: Everything you need to know about our services, technologies, and development process.
FAQ.footer: Still have questions? Feel free to contact us and we’ll gladly help you with your project.

f1.a: We specialize in modern web development, mobile applications, cloud infrastructure, UI/UX design, and scalable digital solutions tailored for businesses and startups.

f2.a: Our primary stack includes Next.js, React, TypeScript, TailwindCSS, Node.js, PostgreSQL, Supabase, Docker, and modern cloud deployment platforms like Vercel.

f3.q: Do you work with international clients?
f3.a: Yes. We work remotely with clients worldwide and communicate in both English and Spanish depending on the project requirements.

f4.q: How long does a project usually take?
f4.a: Project timelines depend on complexity and scope. Small business websites may take a few weeks, while larger platforms or custom systems can take several months.

f5.q: Can you redesign or improve existing platforms?
f5.a: Absolutely. We can modernize outdated systems, improve SEO, optimize performance, redesign interfaces, and scale existing applications.

f6.q: Do you provide ongoing support after launch?
f6.a: Yes. We offer maintenance, monitoring, feature updates, optimization, and technical support after deployment when needed.
